title: Natitingou Branch — Winké
description: Our branch in northwest Benin, part of the Green Dynamic Climate Emergency Program (PDEV-UC). It supports local producers in biowaste valorization and organic farming, linked to the CFL and EPAL training centers in Natitingou where we train.
results: Support for households and farms in the area in adopting biodigesters and biofertilizers.
